title: I’m building an RTS game that progresses while your AI agent is active
author: ConstructionPast442
selftext:
Hi,

I'm currently developing an RTS game inspired by Clash of Clans.

The idea is quite simple: you build your village and attack other players' villages.

The unique aspect is that construction and upgrades are controlled by an AI agent running on your computer. You can only build or upgrade buildings while the agent is active. Meanwhile, villagers continue gathering resources, and you can still raid other players’ villages.

The game currently supports Claude, Codex, OpenCode, and Cursor.

I've attached a quick video to show the gameplay.

I used Codex to build most of the game and generated the character sprites using Google Flow.

I'd be happy to hear what you think about it

comments.author: Pizzaman2948
comments.body: May i ask why play this over an idle game? Because it costs money to run agents?

replies.author: ConstructionPast442
replies.body: I designed this with the intention of playing against other developers on my team or within my company. The core concept is simple: the more you work with agents, the more your in-game village will grow and develop. Therefore, the game is primarily targeted at software developers
